transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name's Ravi. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Ravi. The S-Net TV app on my laptop keeps showing error 4 0 7 and won't play anything. I've tried twice today already, it's really annoying.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry you've had a frustrating time with it, Chiara. Let's sort it. Can I take your date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. What device are you using?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what error code do you see?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 4 0 7. I said that at the start.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Does the app work on your phone, if you try it there?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it works on my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And what device was it that isn't working?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right. Error 407 on Safari is a known problem with the latest update. Could you try it in Chrome instead?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me open Chrome. Logging in. It's playing!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. We'll have a Safari fix out next week. Is it working well enough for now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's working in Chrome. Thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Chiara. Enjoy your evening.
